info.name: NGINX njs Scripting Connections Method DELETE API
Method DELETE
NGINX Reset NGINX Processes Statistics

items.docs: Resets counters of abnormally terminated and respawned child processes.

info.name: NGINX Reset Client Connections Statistics

items.docs: Resets statistics of accepted and dropped client connections.

info.name: NGINX Reset Slab Statistics

params.name: slabZoneName
params.description: The name of the shared memory zone with slab allocator.

items.docs: Resets the “<literal>reqs</literal>” and “<literal>fails</literal>” metrics for each memory slot.

info.name: NGINX Reset HTTP Requests Statistics

items.docs: Resets the number of total client HTTP requests.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for an HTTP Server Zone

params.name: httpServerZoneName
params.description: The name of an HTTP server zone.

items.docs: Resets statistics of accepted and discarded requests, responses, received and sent bytes, counters of SSL handshakes and session reuses in a particular HTTP server zone.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for a Location Zone

items.docs: Resets statistics of accepted and discarded requests, responses, received and sent bytes in a particular location zone.

info.name: NGINX Reset Cache Statistics

params.name: httpCacheZoneName
params.description: The name of the cache zone.

items.docs: Resets statistics of cache hits/misses in a particular cache zone.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for an HTTP Limit_conn Zone

items.docs: Resets the connection limiting statistics.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for an HTTP Limit_req Zone

items.docs: Resets the requests limiting statistics.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics of an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of an HTTP upstream server group.

items.docs: Resets the statistics for each upstream server in an upstream server group and queue statistics.

info.name: NGINX Remove a Server from an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of the upstream server group.

items.docs: Removes a server from an HTTP upstream server group.

info.name: NGINX Empty the HTTP Keyval Zone

params.name: httpKeyvalZoneName
params.description: The name of an HTTP keyval shared memory zone.

items.docs: Deletes all key-value pairs from the HTTP keyval shared memory [zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_keyval_module.html#keyval_zone). If synchronization of keyval zones in a cluster is enabled, empties the keyval zone only on a target cluster node.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for a Stream Server Zone

params.name: streamServerZoneName
params.description: The name of a stream server zone.

items.docs: Resets statistics of accepted and discarded connections, sessions, received and sent bytes, counters of SSL handshakes and session reuses in a particular stream server zone.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for a Stream Limit_conn Zone

items.docs: Resets the connection limiting statistics.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics of a Stream Upstream Server Group

params.name: streamUpstreamName
params.description: The name of a stream upstream server group.

items.docs: Resets the statistics for each upstream server in an upstream server group.

info.name: NGINX Remove a Server from a Stream Upstream Server Group

params.name: streamUpstreamName
params.description: The name of the upstream server group.

items.docs: Removes a server from a stream server group.

info.name: NGINX Empty the Stream Keyval Zone

params.name: streamKeyvalZoneName
params.description: The name of a stream keyval shared memory zone.

items.docs: Deletes all key-value pairs from the stream keyval shared memory [zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_keyval_module.html#keyval_zone). If synchronization of keyval zones in a cluster is enabled, empties the keyval zone only on a target cluster node.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for a Resolver Zone

params.name: resolverZoneName
params.description: The name of a resolver zone.

items.docs: Resets statistics in a particular resolver zone.

info.name: NGINX Reset SSL Statistics

items.docs: Resets counters of SSL handshakes and session reuses.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for All Worker Processes

items.docs:
Resets statistics for all worker processes such as
accepted, dropped, active, idle connections, total and current requests.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for a Worker Process

params.name: workerId
params.description: The ID of the worker process.

items.docs:
Resets statistics of accepted, dropped, active, idle connections,
as well as total and current requests.
